[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-3j[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Excellent shell completion for bob, plus just install[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pressing TAB after `bob` in zsh (and bash) offers grouped, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]described, vault-aware completions computed live by the installed [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bob binary, so completion can never drift from the CLI; `bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]completion` installs, inspects, and removes the shell adapter [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]safely and honestly; and `just install` installs bob from source [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and keeps its shell completion current in one step.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
